requirements.requirement: Signed-in people see only their own company’s records.
requirements.action: Use two fake companies with reused document numbers. Sign in to each and attempt to open the other company’s record.
requirements.expected: Other company’s records cannot be read or changed.

requirements.requirement: Only people with the right role may perform restricted actions.
requirements.hazard: Staff can approve or administer without permission
requirements.action: Try restricted navigation and actions as workshop, office and admin.
requirements.expected: Each action follows the role gate; denied actions change nothing.

requirements.requirement: Money calculations keep exact pence and handle rounding consistently.
requirements.action: Run the money edge cases; make a fake quote with fractional quantities and VAT. Compare its saved and printed totals.
requirements.expected: Expected pence match; no silent fractional-penny drift.

requirements.requirement: A draft invoice does not count as an issued invoice or an approved payment.
requirements.action: Create a fake draft and try the draft-payment cases.
requirements.expected: Draft remains a draft; no issued debt or payment is created.

requirements.requirement: Reopening a finished job requires confirmation, approval handling and a recorded reason.
requirements.action: Reopen a fake finished job. Try cancel, admin approval and notification without an admin present.
requirements.expected: Cancel does nothing; confirmed route records approval/notification and reason without blaming staff.

requirements.requirement: Hours use the saved company break rule; JNR starts with unpaid breaks.
requirements.action: Run clock and break cases; compare an eight-hour fake shift with breaks paid and unpaid.
requirements.expected: Saved rule is followed and the displayed paid hours agree with clock records.

requirements.requirement: The print pack uses the selected company layout and matching document totals.
requirements.hazard: Wrong drawing or paperwork reaches the floor
requirements.action: Preview JNR and basic print layouts using fake records.
requirements.expected: Selected layout, document number, drawing and totals belong to the selected job/company.

requirements.requirement: Important changes have a who, what and when record.
requirements.action: Change a fake record as an ordinary user and inspect the audit as an admin.
requirements.expected: Audit records actor, action and time; staff cannot erase the history.

requirements.requirement: Xero, Sage and QuickBooks keep encrypted tokens, company records and provider results separate; exports require connection, mappings and a permitted action.
requirements.hazard: Leaked tokens, mixed company/provider records or duplicate accounting exports
requirements.action: Rehearse Xero, Sage and QuickBooks separately and side by side with fake provider accounts; verify missing setup, token privacy, mappings, roles, disconnect and uncertain delivery.
requirements.expected: Only the selected company/provider is used; tokens stay encrypted and hidden; unconfigured/unmapped or unauthorised sends refuse; uncertain results are checked before retry.
requirements.gap: Expanded Sage/QuickBooks SQL permissions are added in draft #256, not in this candidate. Successful provider rehearsals remain NOT RUN until sandbox registrations exist.

requirements.requirement: AI is off until allowed; own-key and Tolra-provided modes never share keys; only Rhys with MFA sets each company cap (default 1000p, maximum 100000p); concurrent reservations never exceed it; suggestions need a person.
requirements.hazard: Cross-company key disclosure, unauthorised cap changes or overspending
requirements.action: Switch both configured AI modes, test key isolation and refusal, owner MFA and separate company caps, then obtain real independent-session near-cap race evidence.
requirements.expected: Off stays off; saved keys never appear; no fallback to the other key; company admins cannot raise provided caps; A changes leave B unchanged; over-cap and racing reservations cannot overspend.
requirements.gap: Owner cap SQL ACL expansion is in drafts #254/#256, not in this candidate; the existing real cap race is mapped but NOT RUN here.

requirements.requirement: N5 creates a blank company and saves the guided setup only for its own admins, across existing Settings, Users, Integrations and Import pages.
requirements.hazard: Another company data or unauthorised setup progress appears
requirements.action: Create a third unused company, inspect all business lists, follow every setup link, save selected progress and repeat as staff and both support modes.
requirements.expected: No sample or other-company records appear; setup progress persists only for own admins; optional integrations stay off.

requirements.requirement: N6 uses labelled subject, greeting, main message and sign-off boxes, detail buttons and an example preview for chase and timesheet templates; old saved text stays exact and read-only staff cannot save.
requirements.hazard: Template editing changes legacy email text or allows unauthorised changes
requirements.action: Edit chase and timesheet examples using detail buttons, compare previews and saved legacy text, then repeat as read-only staff.
requirements.expected: No bracket typing needed; preview alone saves/sends nothing; old stored text remains exact; read-only cannot save.

requirements.requirement: Chasing sends only the exact approved recipient, subject and body once; edits invalidate approval; ambiguous customer names refuse at draft creation and approval; uncertain delivery never automatically resends.
requirements.hazard: Wrong customer or unapproved/duplicate message is sent
requirements.action: Use duplicate-name fake customers, review and edit a ZZ draft, compare the exact catcher text, double-send, stale review and uncertain delivery.
requirements.expected: No ambiguous draft/send; exact saved text is sent once; stale review refuses; uncertain result needs checking and does not resend.
requirements.gap: Full DB-backed approved-text/unknown-delivery transport proof is in draft #255, not in this candidate. Unit and SQL claim tests alone do not complete that proof.

requirements.requirement: Customer paid claims and inbound paid/remittance/payment-sent emails never record a payment or change invoice paid fields, balance or status automatically.
requirements.hazard: An email incorrectly clears a real debt
requirements.action: Record a fake paid claim, resume it without receipt, then feed all three inbound phrases and compare complete invoice/payment snapshots for two companies and duplicate messages.
requirements.expected: Claims pause chasing only; inbound evidence is retained; only a separately authorised payment action changes paid financials.
requirements.gap: URS-014 inbound-email subcondition has NO dedicated automated regression on #247. #241 supplies the unit evidence and draft #253 adds real delegated-RPC financial invariance. Neither is folded here. G03.4 is the mapped manual proof and remains NOT RUN. The customer-says-paid UI unit is supporting claim evidence only.

requirements.requirement: JNR cutover requires reviewed 140/141, complete exact-pence reconciliation and same-commit release evidence before a human decision.
requirements.hazard: Wrong data or incomplete evidence accepted at cutover
requirements.action: Check required release files, missing/stale/failed evidence refusals, offline JNR comparison and fake-only SliQ dry run.
requirements.expected: Missing proof refuses; protected records remain equal; fake runs cannot write or approve release.
requirements.gap: Real backup restore, exact combined wipe, actual JNR mapping/import/reconciliation and post-release browser evidence are NOT TESTED locally.
